subject: science
passage: Different birds prefer different seeds, so the food in a feeder affects which birds visit it. In a backyard in Ohio, birdwatcher Grace Whitfield filled four identical feeders with four kinds of seed and counted bird visits over one week. The seed that drew the most visits was ______

data.title: Bird Visits to Four Backyard Feeders over One Week

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?

choices.A: black-oil sunflower seed, which drew 412 visits.
choices.C: millet, which drew birds of six different species.

explanation.why: The statement is about the most visits, so check the "Bird visits" column. The largest number there is 412, for black-oil sunflower seed.
explanation.A: Correct. Black-oil sunflower seed drew 412 visits, more than any other seed.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Safflower drew the fewest visits of the four seeds, not the most.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is about the number of species, not the number of visits, and millet drew only 189 visits.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Nyjer drew 238 visits, the second-highest number, but fewer than sunflower seed's 412.
